# `emptySchemaStruct`

Detects Schema.Struct({}), which accepts any non-null value without validation

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Correctness |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377176`, `TS377177` |
| Language Service name | `emptySchemaStruct` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/empty-schema-struct` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Schema } from "effect"

export const Empty = Schema.Struct({})
/**
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(empty-schema-struct): `Schema.Struct({})` models the type `{}`, so any non-null value passes decoding unvalidated. Use an object-keyword schema (`Schema.ObjectKeyword` in v4, `Schema.Object` in v3) for "any object", a record schema for open key/value maps, or add the intended fields.
*/
export const decoded = Schema.decodeUnknownSync(Empty)(42)
```
